description:
Write a WhatsApp message template and submit it to Meta for review. It is PENDING until Meta approves it, usually within minutes; only approved templates can be sent. Number the values in the body {{1}}, {{2}}, ... and give one example value for each, in order. Use UTILITY for confirmations, reminders and updates, MARKETING for offers. Show the user the wording before submitting: Meta reviews it as written.

Requires scope `whatsapp:write`.

account_id.description: The WhatsApp number whose account will own the template.

body.description: The message, up to 1024 characters, with {{1}}, {{2}}, ... for values.

examples.description: One sample value per placeholder, in order.

footer.description: Optional small last line, up to 60 characters.

header.description: Optional bold first line, up to 60 characters, no placeholders.

language.description: A WhatsApp language code; en_US if omitted.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. visit_reminder.

name: create_whatsapp_template
title: Create a WhatsApp template
